decision: An attributed supervised class-geometry ingredient is worth one native SAGE comparison; universal architecture transfer is not required.
mechanism: Mean native own CE plus .05 single-view SupCon Eq2 on each route's same-forward preclassifier H; all580 TRAIN, exact self excluded, tau .2, normalize eps1e-12, native probability-mean serving.
prediction: Uniform positive targets train difficult same-label examples rather than allowing one already-close exemplar to satisfy class-mass retrieval; useful native class discrimination may improve final predictions.
harm: Same-label multimodal graph evidence can be overcompressed; optimization/member confidence can deteriorate; no new information or competence guarantee.
